title: ReplicateMekanism
description: Wow, Mekanism is replication!! Adds integration between Mekanism and Replication
body:
ReplicateMekanism

JP

ReplicateMekanismでは、MekanismとReplicationを連携し、2種類の機械を追加します。
"複製機(Replicator)"より大容量で、速く処理する"幻想具現化機(Imaginator)"
"崩壊機(Disintegrator)"より容量が多い、"現実崩落機(Reallity Collapser)"
などを駆使して、最終目標の機械の成果物を2倍に強化する、"レプリカアップグレード(Replica Upgrade)"を目指します。

機械を作るために必要な、"レプリカ制御回路(Replica Control Circuit)"や、それを作るための"レプリカ合金(Replica Alloy)"なども追加されますよ！！

EN

ReplicateMekanism integrates Mekanism and Replication to introduce two new types of machines.
The “Imaginator,” which has a larger capacity and processes data faster than the “Replicator,”
and the “Reality Collapser,” which has a larger capacity than the “Disintegrator,”
By making full use of these and other machines, we aim to achieve a “Replica Upgrade,” which doubles the output of the target machine.

We’re also adding the “Replica Control Circuit,” which is necessary for building machines, as well as “Replica Alloy,” used to craft it!!
